description: TypeSafe System One evaluation and routing architecture using the flagship Jev model for natural language intent resolution, category classification, unit normalization, and confidence gating.

user_query.description: Raw natural language utterance entered by the user in the command bar.

primitives.instructions: Determine the primary operational intent of the user request based on semantics and keywords.

criteria.unit_conversion: User wants to convert quantities, measurements, temperatures, bytes, or physical dimensions between units.
criteria.math_game: User wants to solve an arithmetic puzzle, play a calculation game, or practice mental math.
criteria.formula_explanation: User is asking for scientific formulas, mathematical derivations, or conversion constants.
criteria.unrecognized: Query does not express a supported intent.

primitives.instructions: When intent is 'unit_conversion', identify the exact physical dimension domain.

criteria.length: Meters, kilometers, centimeters, millimeters, miles, yards, feet, inches, nautical miles.
criteria.weight: Kilograms, grams, milligrams, tons, pounds, ounces, stones, carats.
criteria.volume: Liters, milliliters, gallons, quarts, pints, cups, fluid ounces, cubic meters, tablespoons.
criteria.time: Seconds, milliseconds, microseconds, nanoseconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, years.
criteria.data: Bits, bytes, kilobytes, megabytes, gigabytes, terabytes, petabytes.
criteria.speed: Meters per second, kilometers per hour, miles per hour, knots, mach, speed of light.
criteria.energy: Joules, kilojoules, calories, kilocalories, watt-hours, kilowatt-hours, electronvolts.

primitives.instructions: Select the exact candidate tokens representing numerical magnitude, source unit, and target destination unit.
Evaluate whether the joint probability of the intent, category, and extracted entities exceeds the operational threshold to execute automated UI re-routing without human disambiguation.
